node.title: Over-budget rank-twelve sources force massive full-rank tiny-defect families
node.statement: For every original KoalaBear rank-twelve normalized source on J9941..21499 and every valid reselection in its fixed actual dimension11 carrier, sum min(raw,4)<=624373932788019251, proved by eight quadratic certificates with core gap67347 and an all-HIGH gate. An over-budget original line has at least100284125772880591 raw<=2 labels and158516326552340442 raw<=3 labels; their actual parameter graphs have affine dimensions>=11 and exactly12. On J>=14000 at least27280579497297684 raw-one labels have graph dimension>=11. The nested flag forces either raw-one graph dimension>=11 or raw<=2 graph dimension12. The corresponding low-rank alternatives pay whole original sources, including near once; the largest printed cap is273667628828640978. Canonical maximizing selection identifies complete-set defects, and more than10^11 distinct represented polynomial pairs have joint cores of size>=m-2. Rank margins survive the existing secant/zero exceptions. No full-rank low-defect census, complete J interval, rank>=13, unrestricted MCA, LIST or full Prize closure is claimed.
